dedupe_keys.name: 淹水潛勢圖 flood and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 淹水潛勢圖 [flood and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 淹水潛勢圖是經設計降雨情境、特定水文地文條件及水理模式演算，模擬防洪設施於正常運作下可能的淹水情形。 淹水潛勢圖之內容包含透過降雨組體圖說明設計降雨情境、依據不同淹水深度級距以不同顏色標示該淹水深度之範圍、使用限制說明。 淹水潛勢圖係為預先掌握災害風險而產製，目前淹水潛勢圖無法模擬未來颱洪事件的降水歷程與淹水狀況，故產製時係依據水文分析之... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
